name: One World International School
summary: IB programmes with campuses serving west and other corridors at relatively accessible fees.
body:
OWIS positions as a more accessible IB option versus legacy mega-campuses. Campus locations have expanded over time — match the site to your commute. Useful comparison school when packages are mid-range. Confirm how external ed-psych reports are reviewed and whether tutoring on campus is facilitated or parent-managed.

Confirm exactly which campus any fee quote and bus route belongs to before comparing against single-campus schools. Multi-campus operators shift year groups between sites as cohorts grow. West-side families usually find the commute maths most forgiving.
waitlistNotes: Generally more mid-year flexibility — still confirm by grade.
